integrity: Reproducible direct shortest-path finite enumeration supports but does not prove the universal result. Its proof is given in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to two-factor rectangular rook graphs, labels every board cell, and counts inclusion-maximal rather than maximum-cardinality configurations or game strategies. Previous results establish both endpoints of the spectrum. Publication priority against differently formulated spanning-star-forest enumerations remains uncertain; independent validation was not performed.
title: Exact maximal general-position polynomials and cardinality gaps in rectangular rook graphs
